name: Dimitri Volkov
bio: Dimitri's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, repairing fiberglass boats on the Volga River. His innate understanding of composite materials and meticulous attention to detail quickly set him apart. A chance encounter with a touring car team led to an apprenticeship, and he hasn't looked back since. He approaches composite work with a scientist's curiosity and an artist's touch, always seeking the optimal balance between strength and weight. Known for his calm demeanor and unwavering focus, he's a reliable presence in high-pressure situations. He thrives on challenging projects and is always eager to experiment with new materials and techniques, striving to push the boundaries of what's possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a wiry build, suggesting he's stronger than he looks.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a collection of miniature Formula 1 cars on his workbench.
Mumbles engineering calculations to himself while working.
